t: This is Gresham College, at Barnard's Inn Hall off Holborn. It's an unusual institution, because it takes no students and awards no degrees. Instead it hosts over 140 free public lectures every year, and since 2001 they've all been available online. It was founded in 1597 under the will of Sir Thomas Gresham, the merchant and financier who served Edward VI, Mary I and Elizabeth I, and who founded the Royal Exchange in 1565. Free learning for anyone is his legacy here.
